name: Cu Mong crab
summary: Crab from đầm Cù Mông. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 29 December 2020 note says the meat is sweet and fragrant, steamed until the shell is red and the meat is white, with salt, pepper, and lime. It also names ghẹ rang muối, ghẹ rim me, and súp ghẹ. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Yen. Đầm Cù Mông, on Du lịch Phú Yên’s 29 December 2020 note.
taste: Sweet and fragrant. That is the 29 December 2020 note. The steamed plate is white meat with salt, pepper, and lime.
howToEat: Steam it until the shell is red and the meat is white, and dip it in salt, pepper, and lime. The same note also names ghẹ rang muối, ghẹ rim me, and súp ghẹ. A price is Check on arrival. An hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Đầm Cù Mông. A street and a distance from Tuy Hòa were not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Cu Mong crab — steamed, with salt, pepper, and lime
seoDescription: Crab from dam Cu Mong, steamed until red, with salt, pepper, and lime. Rang muoi, rim me, and soup are also named. A price is Check on arrival.
